---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement for SecureClaw
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see added.

## Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? What use case does it address?

## Proposed Solution

How would you like to see this implemented? Include as much detail as possible.

## Alternative Solutions

Are there alternative approaches you've considered? Why is your proposed solution better?

## Additional Context

- Would this be a breaking change?
- What security implications does this have?
- Which security tiers would this apply to?
- Any examples from other projects?

## Implementation Notes

If you have ideas about how this could be implemented:

- Required dependencies or tools
- Changes to installation flow
- Configuration changes needed
- Potential challenges

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues to ensure this hasn't been requested
- [ ] I have clearly described the problem this solves
- [ ] I have considered security implications
- [ ] I have considered compatibility with existing features
